[https://enode.com/company]
Company | Enode Skip to content Sign in Talk to our team Why we exist The grid is the greatest machine ever built It was designed for a world where energy flowed in one direction, from the few who produced it to the many who used it. That world has moved on. Energy now lives across homes, cars, batteries, and solar panels, in millions of devices. The grid has to connect all this distributed energy, orchestrate it, and let it respond in real time. That’s flexibility: moving energy to where and when it’s needed. This is the shift we’re powering. We build the connectivity that brings these pieces together, and the orchestration that gives them rhythm. We’re the invisible enabler of a connected energy system. We’re building the next grid. Get in touch See open roles 1,000 + Energy device models supported 1.7 M+ Connected households 5,000 + MW Controllable load on the platform How we work The principles that guide how we build Validate in the real world We test everything where it counts: in real systems, under real conditions, with real stakes. We know how a heat pump behaves at minus ten degrees and what happens to EV charging when the grid is stressed. Make complexity invisible The energy system is messy underneath. Our job is to make sure none of that reaches our partners. Clean abstractions, clear documentation, and predictable behavior. Build for what’s next Today’s grid was designed for a world that no longer exists. We don’t patch the old system. We build the software layer the new system needs, connecting the pieces across devices, partners, and platforms. Make others successful The measure isn’t what we ship. It’s what our partners can build because of it. When they move faster, reach more customers, and build better products, we’ve done our job. Where to find us Meet us at these events Nov 2–3 Future of Utilities London, UK Nov 10–12 Enlit Vienna, Austria Meet the team 60+ people across Europe and beyond.
